ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future Scam: A Deep Dive
ideas.description: An investigative report on the Feeding Our Future scam, which involved the misuse of $2.8 million in federal funds meant for child nutrition programs.
questions: How did they carry out the scam?
ideas.insight: The Feeding Our Future scam highlights the need for greater oversight and accountability in the use of federal funds.

ideas.title: DHS Shutdown: Impact on Minnesota
ideas.description: An investigative report on the impact of the DHS shutdown on Minnesota, including effects on ICE, TSA, and FEMA.
questions: How will the shutdown affect Minnesota?
ideas.insight: The DHS shutdown may have significant impacts on Minnesota, particularly in terms of border security and law enforcement.
